## About
Rick's Service Center & Towing has been providing quality car care in Indianapolis for years. Our technicians use the latest technology and work on all major and minor repairs, foreign and domestic.
One reviewer wrote that she was looking for a local shop she could build a relationship with, and found it when she met Marc. Her family has kept their vehicles with us ever since, and her kids know to call Marc when something comes up.
We're rated 4.4 from 129 Google reviews. Have a question about your car or want advice on taking better care of it? Ask us and we'll help.

## Services
- Preventative Maintenance: Regular maintenance to keep your vehicle in top shape.
- Oil Change: We change your oil and check your vehicle for any potential problems while it's here.
- Brake Repair: Hearing squeaking or grinding? We're equipped to repair all brake systems.
- Exhaust System: From the engine to the exhaust pipe, we work on all parts of the exhaust system.
- Air Conditioning Service: If your vehicle needs air conditioning repair, bring it in and we'll fix it quickly.
- Axle Repair: Axles are an essential part of your steering system. We'll take care of them.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Send us an appointment request and we'll be in touch within 24 hours to schedule a time that works well for you.

Q: Can I wait while you work on my car?
A: When you request an appointment, you can tell us whether you'll wait for your vehicle or leave it with us.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. Our mechanics handle major and minor repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles.
